gen-audiowide-gf-chivo: Chivo reads like a plain sans with its lowercase pushed up toward the caps and daylight in every curve. Chivo carries on that way down a full page, while Audiowide stays tile-like and single-toned above it.
gen-audiowide-gf-chocolate-classical-san: Sci-fi tiles on top, a broad-nibbed pen below that never curls shut, with Audiowide holding one stroke width in every glyph. Audiowide does the loud futuristic work; Chocolate Classical Sans handles the talking.
gen-audiowide-gf-comme: Wire-thin, techy and spaced like tiles. Audiowide sets the mood in its tall lowercase, then Comme follows with a smooth, modern plain sans whose curves never clog, so the page moves from gadget to conversation without a bump.
gen-audiowide-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte has wide-eyed e shapes and a prominent x-height. Audiowide above it brings tall lowercase and tile-like glyphs, so the sans-serif below feels like the quiet answer to a loud futuristic line.
gen-audiowide-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans keeps its small letters wide open, with bodies that dominate the line while the ascenders barely show. Lines run smoothly down the page, and Audiowide never leaves a hairline to squint at above.
gen-audiowide-gf-fresca: Audiowide's glyphs sit like tiles with wide grout lines. It does the futuristic shouting, while Fresca does the quiet job of keeping its counters connected to the space outside, with short ascenders over big bowls.
gen-audiowide-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans keeps its ascenders tight to the x-height line. Its strongest quality is stroke widths that stay put from stem to curve, which gives the tech-flavored Audiowide above it something steady to lean on.
gen-audiowide-gf-gafata: Futuristic is the first impression, from Audiowide's tile-like glyphs and strokes with no thick-to-thin shading. And Gafata, a tall band of letters with short stalks and wide-eyed e shapes, earns its place down below by staying out of the way.
gen-audiowide-gf-geist: Audiowide brings tall lowercase and tile-like glyphs with wide grout lines to the top. And Geist, a plain sans with a level beat, lets words read as solid blocks rather than skylines, so a long passage goes down smoothly.
gen-audiowide-gf-georama: Audiowide has no hairlines to squint at, even small. Its strongest quality is the pull between that tile-like, futuristic heading and Georama, a friendly sans with a bracelet-wide c and barely rising capitals.
